description: Land Title Settlement Department - Welipaththayaya, Balangoda D/S Division, Ratnapura District    -  Cad. Map No. 620003
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration, ownership determinations, and property rights - all characteristics of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
